proposals.title: FIRST STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing Schwab's direct and indirect lobbying, grassroots lobbying communications, related payments, recipients, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: We recommend a vote against the first stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: Elect Each Director Annually – Proposal 5
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, on behalf of James McRitchie
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the company to reorganize the Board into one class with each director elected annually for a one-year term.
proposals.evidence: For these reasons, we recommend a vote against the second stockholder proposal.
